question: Which export goods experienced the largest declines in value between 2019 and 2020 in Luxembourg?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
2.6 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
SELECT
  year,
  hs2 AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2021-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'export'
  AND year IN (2019, 2020)
GROUP BY
  year,
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  year,
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: Largest changes by product group — exports 2019–2020

insight: The export goods that experienced the largest declines in value between 2019 and 2020 in Luxembourg were Electrical machinery and equipment, which fell by 1.49 billion euros.
Electrical machinery and equipment exports decreased from 2.12 billion euros in 2019 to 637.4 million euros in 2020, a 70.0% drop.
Iron and steel exports also saw a notable decline, dropping by 404.7 million euros from 1.56 billion euros in 2019 to 1.15 billion euros in 2020.
Machinery and mechanical appliances exports decreased by 232.2 million euros, from 1.86 billion euros in 2019 to 1.63 billion euros in 2020.
The data values are nominal and not adjusted for price changes, and 2.6% of the export values are confidential and not detailed.
